items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Exact decision: block security-sensitive releases, gated public exposure, and go-live decisions; conditionally allow ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no completed run; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; security sitefacts are unknown across 61 managed sites; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release integrity, dependency provenance, TLS beyond limited HTTPS checks, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance reports 35 passes, 20 fails, and 6 unknowns across 61 sites, but does not establish security clearance. Risk severity is high for go-live, public exposure, and security-sensitive releases; medium for contained reversible growth. Missing evidence is not treated as proof of compromise or a clean bill of health.

Retain the existing read-only security evidence matrix. Record dated authorized evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release and deploy controls, TLS, dependency and supply-chain provenance, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt or disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, or request duplicate telemetry. Preserve private and preview-only gates until material controls are evidenced.
